# krakenkey_certificate (Data Source)

Reads an existing KrakenKey TLS certificate by ID. The PEM attributes and expiry are only set while the certificate is issued.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "krakenkey_certificate" "existing" {
  id = "42"
}

output "certificate_status" {
  value = data.krakenkey_certificate.existing.status
}

output "certificate_expires_at" {
  value = data.krakenkey_certificate.existing.expires_at
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Certificate ID.

### Read-Only

- `auto_renew` (Boolean) Whether KrakenKey renews the certificate inside the plan's renewal window.
- `cert_pem` (String) Leaf certificate. Most servers want fullchain_pem instead.
- `chain_pem` (String) Intermediate certificates only.
- `csr_pem` (String) PEM certificate signing request the certificate was issued from.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiry, RFC 3339.
- `expires_at_unix` (Number) Expiry as a Unix timestamp. It changes on every renewal.
- `failure_reason` (String) Why the last issuance or renewal failed, if it did.
- `fullchain_pem` (String) Leaf plus intermediates. Deploy this one.
- `renewal_count` (Number) Number of renewals so far.
- `status` (String) pending, issuing, issued, failed, renewing, revoking or revoked.
